thread:
maria (platform): thinking out loud — propose a "delta" privacy mode for short-lived debug captures. idea: capture only diffs/prefix changes + hashed PII instead of full req/resp. would let us keep tiny inspect snapshots for canaries without exposing full payloads. open to pushback.

kevin (eng-ml): curious — diffs only sounds good for token costs. do you mean store token diffs or semantic diffs? token diffs might still leak.

maria (platform): token diffs. smallest unit is token ids we already see. plan: store prefix hashes + a tiny delta blob (max 256 bytes) and metadata: model, seq_len, route, sample_reason.

jean (privacy): flagged. hashed PII vs pseudonymization matters. if legal needs re-identification, hashed-only is not reversible. we need a reversible pseudonymization path gated by HSM and with strict audit logs.

sam (prod): reversible path adds ops complexity. can we keep reversible but only for tenant-requested legal audit and require a court-approved flow? also perf concerns for real-time rollouts.

rachel (support): from support POV, often need to see the small snippet to triage hallucinations. diffs + hashed email isn't enough sometimes. could we allow an on-call breakglass that returns masked-but-readable tokens? e.g., show initials + domain?

kevin (eng-ml): technical tradeoff: reversible tokenization implies lookup store or encrypt-with-key-per-tenant. key-per-tenant with HSM unwrap on demand is ideal but will add latency to inspect calls. how often would support call it?

maria (platform): low frequency (minutes/hours), not in-path for regular requests. we can async-unmask for support-only UI and keep a strict canary flag for sampling. console UX: toggle per-route "delta-inspect" with confirm modal + audit checkbox.

jean (privacy): must include TTL. unmasked artifacts should auto-revoke after X days (default 7). every unmask action should create an immutably logged audit entry with operator id + reason.

maria (platform): agree. proposal sketch in API terms:

```http
POST /v1/responses
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <$TOKEN>
  x-redwood-privacy-mode: delta|full|off
  x-redwood-inspect-reason: canary
Body: { "prompt": "..." }
```

ops-bot: deploy canary: feature/delta-inspect proto -> staging

kevin (eng-ml): note: we can't trust client-supplied x-redwood-privacy-mode for enterprise tenants. tokens should encode the allowed privacy tier (e.g. token.claims.privacy=delta). header can be a hint but server must enforce.

maria (platform): yep — header is advisory. server enforces based on token scopes + route allowlist. console toggle should flip server-side route policy not client header.

rachel (support): UX ask: console should show sampled_rate, scrubbed_tokens_count, last_unmask_time. helpful for handoffs.

maria (platform): telemetry fields we should expose: 
- sample_policy (enum)
- sample_rate (float)
- sample_reason (string)
- scrubbed_tokens_count (int)
- inspect_ttl_days (int)
- unmask_requests (count)

kevin (eng-ml): add metric: avg_unmask_latency_ms and unmask_success_rate. helps ops decide whether to async vs sync.

jean (privacy): we need retention schema doc and SSO access controls. any console unmask button must require MFA and RBAC group "privacy-auditors".

maria (platform): action items:
- (kevin) prototype tokenized-diff capture (client + runtime) — perf budget 5% overhead.
- (jean) write pseudonymization/ HSM spec and audit workflow.
- (sam) sketch console toggle + confirmation UI + RBAC gating.
- (rachel) list common support cases that require unmask and examples.

kevin (eng-ml): timeline? can do a small proto in 2 weeks. will mock sample payload sizes.

jean (privacy): will draft spec and legal constraints this week.

rachel (support): I'll gather support examples and pain points by EoW.

maria (platform): thanks all. small clarifying note on storage: delta captures are stored in encrypted S3 with envelope encryption; keys rotated monthly. unmask requires HSM unwrap + KMS audit event.

sam (prod): one last ops ask — per-tenant quota for inspect storage. we should avoid a tenant burning our S3 with noisy canaries. suggest per-tenant inspect budget + quota alerts in console.

maria (platform): agreed. add quota fields: inspect_quota_bytes, inspect_quota_used. console will show and auto-disable canary sampling when quota low.

kevin (eng-ml): minor: when sampling diffs, consider truncating token diffs to token-ids + counts instead of raw text to reduce leakage.

jean (privacy): final: no plaintext emails/SSNs in any stored blob. if we detect pattern match, redact and replace with <REDACTED:PII_TYPE>.

maria (platform): ok let's sync tomorrow 11am PT to review proto results. thanks :thumbsup:

ops-bot: meeting created: "delta-inspect proto review" 11:00 PT tomorrow (calendar invite sent).
